3.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_001
5.description: I was stationed here shortly after the castellum was liberated from the Garleans.

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_002
6.description: Although I was later assigned to the Velodyna Gatekeepers, my role remains much the same.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_010
7.description: This was simply called Velodyna bridge before the Garleans arrived. They saw fit to transform it into a base for their supply trains.

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_011
8.description: Following their departure, it was left to fall into disrepair. That was until Captain Alpa suggested putting it to good use.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_020
9.description: We Gatekeepers are dedicated to our work, but unfortunately we are rather lacking in numbers. Eshana is always looking to hire adventurers, if you're interested.

10.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_030
10.description: The griffin statues are truly remarkable. I heard that Alpa had a gift for metalwork, but I had no idea she was so artistic.

11.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_040
11.description: Those guest rooms have made a world of difference. I'd much rather travelers slept here than become a midnight feast for some ghastly creature.

12.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_050
12.description: Now that we have an infirmary, sickly and hobbled travelers can receive proper treatment before they continue on their way.

13.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_051
13.description: Naturally, we Gatekeepers are also glad to have experienced chirurgeons on hand.

14.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_060
14.description: When I heard we were taking in Qalyana deserters, I was extremely apprehensive. And now they're sleeping under the same roof as the Vira!

15.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_061
15.description: If I were sharing quarters with a former enemy, I would be afraid of waking up with a dagger between my ribs. It seems Captain Alpa and her Vira friends are considerably more trusting than I am, though.

16.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_070
16.description: The castellum has certainly changed since the Gatekeepers arrived. Who could have guessed this former Garlean stronghold would become such a lively hub of activity?

17.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_500
17.description: This was simply called Velodyna bridge before the Garleans arrived. They saw fit to transform it into a base for their supply trains.

18.name: TEXT_REGGYR3CASTELLUMVELODYNA_00458_SLEEPINGCOEURL_000_501
18.description: What's more, atop this tower they could survey the area for malms around. Their ambition knows no bounds, nor does their villainy.
